item.title: fix(telegram): requeue aborted ingress claims (#122864)
item.summary: fix(telegram): requeue aborted ingress claims (#122864) Requeue Telegram ingress claims when their owner aborts before adoption, without spending retry attempts or misclassifying late aborts as delivery failures. During managed shutdown, drain active embedded model and tool runs before exit, with a 330-second generated systemd stop budget for the 315-second cooperative gateway drain. Co-authored-by: jisubi Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
